summary: Tested P0 seed-demo bulk insert + idempotency and P1 global athlete (player) filter on staff dashboard (backend + frontend). 21/21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend E2E verified: athlete filter dropdown selects single athlete, all 11 dashboard endpoints receive athlete_id query param, stats card updates from 22 -> 1, chart shows only selected athlete's line.

issues: Dropdown lists athletes with duplicate display names (e.g. 'Lucas Silva' appears twice as two different IDs/emails). This is LEGITIMATE data per agent_to_agent_context_note, but UX could be improved by appending email or team to disambiguate (e.g. 'Lucas Silva (Men)').

passed_tests: GET /api/seed-demo completes in <30s (actual: ~1-2s) and returns success:true with staff/athletes/data_created
GET /api/seed-demo is idempotent: second call reports all 16 athletes + 3 staff as 'exists:' and data_created='0 check-ins, 0 sessions'
GET /api/staff/dashboard/stats?team=Brazil Lacrosse Men&athlete_id=<women_id> returns 0 (out of scope)
GET /api/staff/dashboard/charts?athlete_id=<id>&days=14 returns athletes=[single_name] and readiness/load rows only have date + that athlete key
All 10 dashboard/alert endpoints (stats, charts, menstrual-stats, pain-analytics, workload-metrics, readiness-radar, daily-pain, acwr, longterm, alerts) accept athlete_id and return 200
DELETE /api/admin/clear-demo-data requires admin auth (401/403 without token)
Frontend: athlete-filter dropdown opens with 22 athlete options + 'All Players'
Frontend: selecting 'Lucas Silva' fires 11 dashboard requests all carrying athlete_id query param
Frontend: ATHLETES KPI card updates 22 -> 1 after selection; chart legend shows only 'Lucas Silva'
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: athlete filter dropdown shows duplicate athlete names (legitimate but confusing). Consider appending team initial or email suffix in SelectItem label.
Server.py is 5533 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, staff_dashboard, admin, seed) for maintainability.
seed-demo endpoint is exposed as BOTH GET and POST without auth. For production safety consider moving to admin-only or gating behind env flag DEMO_SEED_ENABLED.
TestAdminRegression uses fake ids without auth header on delete endpoints (returned 404/401 either way) - main agent may want to add a fixture creating real records to fully exercise the delete path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (filter end-to-end works, all 11 endpoints receive athlete_id)

seed_data_creation: Re-ran GET /api/seed-demo (idempotent). 16 demo athletes + 3 staff + ~30 days of readiness/sessions data already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: seed-demo bulk insert (insert_many in batches of 500) is verified production-ready: completes <2s in preview, idempotent (uses pre-fetched key sets), and second run inserts 0 new records. Global athlete filter (athlete_id query param) is implemented on /api/staff/dashboard/{stats,charts,menstrual-stats,pain-analytics,workload-metrics,readiness-radar,daily-pain,acwr,longterm} and /api/staff/alerts. Frontend StaffDashboard.js passes athlete_id on all dashboard/alert fetches and dedupes chart athlete names via Set. Use 6s wait after login before clicking athlete-filter dropdown — 'Welcome back!' toast intercepts clicks earlier. Note: DB has 22 athletes total in preview (6 pre-existing + 16 demo).
